## Perspective Audit Summary

**Component/artifact reviewed:** `MediaPlayer` (Fixture: Media Player With Caption Support)
**Perspectives escalated for deep review:** Auditory Access, Screen Reader & Semantic Structure
**Perspectives at LOW (not reviewed):** Magnification & Reflow, Environmental Contrast, Vestibular & Motion Sensitivity, Keyboard & Motor Access, Cognitive & Neurodivergent

### Findings by Severity

| Severity | Count |
|---|---|
| CRITICAL | 0 |
| MAJOR | 0 |

### Perspectives That Passed (Code-Level)

- **Auditory Access:** All code-level checklist items pass. Captions track is present and valid, transcript is adjacent in markup, controls are natively keyboard-operable, and `autoPlay` is disabled.
- **Screen Reader & Semantic Structure:** All code-level checklist items pass. Landmarks, heading hierarchy, DOM order, form labels, and ARIA roles match APG patterns. Focus indicators meet contrast/width thresholds.

### Perspectives With Findings — Grouped by ARRM Role

**Front-End Dev**
- Video element lacks explicit accessible name — Screen Reader & Semantic Structure — MINOR — WCAG 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value)
  - **Evidence:** `MediaPlayer.jsx` line ~38 (`<video ref={videoRef} tabIndex={-1} poster="/img/tutorial-poster.jpg" ...>`)
  - **Fix:** Add `aria-label="Tutorial video player"` to the `<video>` element. While it inherits a name from the parent `<section>`, APG recommends explicit naming on complex media elements to ensure robust announcement across all ATs.

**Auditory Access (Content-Level Flags)**
- Caption accuracy and timing synchronization — `[Human verification required — cannot be confirmed from source]`
- Transcript includes speaker identification for multi-speaker content — `[Human verification required — cannot be confirmed from source]`
- Audio descriptions (`<track kind="descriptions">`) cover all visual-only information in the video — `[Human verification required — cannot be confirmed from source]`

### Recommended Next Step

**REVISE** (Address MINOR finding before shipping)
- Add explicit `aria-label` to the `<video>` element for robust screen reader naming.
- Proceed to content author review for caption accuracy, transcript speaker IDs, and audio description coverage. No CRITICAL or MAJOR barriers detected at code level.
